BPA is definitely a health risk if ingested in sufficient quantities, but there is is currently debate around how much exposure consumer goods and food packaging actually exposes people to Bisphenol A.

Current opinion seems to be that we are not exposed to sufficient amounts for it to be a problem, as only a very tiny amount leeches from the packaging into the food - thought by most not to be enough to have health risks. But it is being actively explored and government agencies - e.g. the EU - are conducting ongoing studies at the time of writing.

It is very widely and openly studied subject about which you can find a huge volume of research and publicly available reasons for regulatory decisions.
